limits: Source-only review; no helper execution or independent test rerun.
Trusted fixed project/evidence directory boundary; no claim of protection from concurrent malicious ancestor redirection.
Application is atomic per file, not a transaction across four files. A failure can leave an explicit partial change with original bytes preserved; no automatic rollback.
Handler/HTML binding temporarily differs from the running old API until the separately reviewed dashboard reload; existing table guards withhold rather than relabel mismatched data.
verified_scope: Pinned specification restricts exactly four named project targets and four matching staged filenames.
Every target original hash, staged hash/size, exact retained before bytes, compile of Python and non-target source dependency is checked before the first target replacement.
Original exact staged bytes are flushed/fsynced, re-read and installed per file, then re-read and all source bindings checked again. Existing line endings are preserved.
No process, worker, model, broker or account operations occur. Receipt is exclusive and reports actual application clocks.
